title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: trade lanes and prohibited ports of discharge
content:
## What this card covers
This card states, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the trade lanes on which the category is carried and the ports of discharge (UN/LOCODE) at which the category is not accepted.

## Trade lanes on which each category is carried
| Trade lane | Limited Quantity | Class 9 Standard | Flammables and Corrosives | Toxics and Oxidizers | Compressed Gases | Special Approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Asia – North Europe | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| Asia – Mediterranean | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| Transpacific Eastbound | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried |
| Asia – US East Coast | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried |
| Transatlantic Westbound | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried |
| Intra-Asia | carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried | not carried |
| Asia – Middle East and India | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried |
| Europe – South America East Coast | carried | carried | carried | carried | carried | not carried |

The column headings abbreviate the category names AHL DG Limited Quantity, AHL DG Class 9 Standard, AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives, AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval.

## Ports of discharge where the category is not accepted
| Category | Prohibited ports of discharge |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | none |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | none |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | none |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | none |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | HKHKG |
| AHL DG Special Approval | SGSIN, HKHKG, AEJEA |

## Basis Q&A
- *On how many lanes is AHL DG Special Approval carried?* Three: Asia – North Europe, Asia – Mediterranean and Transatlantic Westbound.
- *Which lane is closed to AHL DG Compressed Gases?* Intra-Asia is the only one of the eight lanes absent from its list.
- *Is any port of discharge prohibited for AHL DG Class 9 Standard?* No; its list of prohibited ports is empty.
- *Which port appears on two prohibited lists?* HKHKG, for AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval.
